task: 2-D spatial index (quadtree) service with range, radius, k-nearest, polygon, DBSCAN and canonical CRC snapshots
reasoning_summary: Designed a point quadtree with deterministic ordering (distance then id) and a best-first kNN that expands nodes before tied entries. Tests were written first: literal boundary cases, randomized differential checks against brute force with an invariant checker after every mutation, snapshot truncation and byte-flip loops, and DBSCAN against a brute-force oracle. The only failure was a wrong polygon test oracle, not the code.
